WILMINGTON, Del.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Oct. 8, 2026-- Incyte (Nasdaq:INCY) announced today that it has scheduled its third quarter financial results conference call and webcast for 8:00 a.m. ET on Thursday, October 29, 2026.


The schedule for the press release and conference call/webcast is as follows:


- Q3 2026 Press Release: October 29, 2026, at 7:00 a.m. ET
- Q3 2026 Conference Call: October 29, 2026, at 8:00 a.m. ET
- Domestic Dial-In Number: 877-407-3042
- International Dial-In Number: 201-389-0864
- Conference ID Number: 13763051


If you are unable to participate, a replay of the conference will be available for thirty days. The replay dial-in number for the U.S. is 877-660-6853 and the dial-in number for international callers is 201-612-7415. To access the replay you will need the conference identification number 13763051.


A live webcast with slides can be accessed at[Investor.Incyte.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.incyte.com%2F&esheet=54617253&newsitemid=20261008696942&lan=en-US&anchor=Investor.Incyte.com&index=1&md5=15b315596615c6104e6c5efbfeea0837) and will be available for replay for ninety days.


**About Incyte** Incyte is redefining what’s possible in biopharmaceutical innovation. Through deep scientific expertise and a relentless focus on patients, we have built an established portfolio of first-in-class medicines and an extensive portfolio of next-generation medicines across our key franchises: Hematology, Oncology and Inflammation & Autoimmunity.


To learn more, visit[Incyte.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.incyte.com%2F&esheet=54617253&newsitemid=20261008696942&lan=en-US&anchor=Incyte.com&index=2&md5=6aa7c09e26478912e0d6cebe0d489c53) and[Investor.Incyte.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.incyte.com%2F&esheet=54617253&newsitemid=20261008696942&lan=en-US&anchor=Investor.Incyte.com&index=3&md5=3b354551cbdc47eb30067fef8f7a017d) .
